title: Jonah 1:17 and Matthew 12:40 — three days and three nights, Jonah and the Son of Man
summary: Jonah 1:17 (English and Hebrew) is placed above Matthew 12:40, where Jesus says that just as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the great fish, so will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth. “Jonah” is green, “stomach” and “belly” light green.

text.text: 17 And the LORD appointed a great fish to swallow Jonah, and Jonah was in the stomach of the fish three days and three nights.
17 וימן יהוה דג גדול לבלע את־יונה ויהי יונה במעי הדג שלשה ימים ושלשה לילות׃
40 for just as JONAH WAS THREE DAYS AND THREE NIGHTS IN THE BELLY OF THE GREAT FISH, so will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

numbers.note: three days and three nights — Jonah in the fish and the Son of Man in the earth
